title: Campus Bikes
description: Assign bikes to workers such that each worker gets a bike and the sum of Manhattan distances is minimized.
pseudocode:
1. Collect all (distance, worker, bike) triples.
2. Sort triples by distance, then worker, then bike.
3. Iterate and assign if worker/bike are available.
4. Return result array.

steps.note: Triples: (dist, worker, bike) for W0(0,0), B0(0,1), B1(1,1)
